corrections.why: The only source on a structure says no structure was constructed on the 1933 site, and no other source found shows a lookout. If a human confirms, hide the record as never built.

notes_for_editor: The 1933 'no structure constructed' line is a one-line site note and the only evidence about a lookout here. Two searches, the Wikipedia article and the NHLR and FFLOS caches found no lookout on the summit. Hiding as never built is a human call (see the correction). Cheryl Hill's Fire Lookouts of Oregon was suggested by a search result and was not checked. The summit is a climbing peak with no tower; the story does not encourage ascent.
